in_marathi.name: Nivyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे New and Victorious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nivyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Niv means new, and yansh means victorious. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is rooted in Hindu mythology.

in_bengali.name: Nivyansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ New and Victorious
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nivyansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Niv means new, and yansh means victorious. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is rooted in Hindu mythology.
